identification: Set of 6 cane-back dining chairs, Queen Anne revival style: shaped caned backs, cabriole front legs with pad feet, drop-in seats in blue/cream floral fabric. Stained hardwood (oak or beech), c.1920s-1940s.

entries.note: Set of Six Antique Dining Chairs, cane seat, auction, pick-up/free postage field; chairs differ (cane seat, not cane back) but same class.
